common.decision_at: completed day t close, 15:00 Asia/Shanghai; daily row available_at must be no later than decision_at
common.first_order: next legal session open only; no same-close execution
common.capacity: accepted 5 percent of opening-day traded amount semantics
common.execution: T+1, buy/sell price-limit blocks, suspensions, hard-valid rows, and QD-010 pre-effective exits preserved

track_a.architecture_a: exact frozen weekly Industry Diffusion plus weekly Low-MAX replay at each matched cost

architecture_b.industry_clock: each exact weekly cohort retains its frozen signal-date PIT industry counts and original 20-session expiry; industry state is never recomputed between weekly dates
architecture_b.quality: exact maximum causal corporate-action-coordinate daily log return over the 20 sessions ending at completed day t close; lower is better
architecture_b.daily_preference: within each active cohort and frozen industry count, select the lowest exact Low-MAX names from the day-t eligible PIT industry universe; existing selected names win only exact-score ties by symbol
architecture_b.transition: at next open retain every incumbent still preferred; pair removed incumbents and newly preferred names deterministically by symbol; replace only when the incumbent is legally sellable and the target legally buyable at that same open
architecture_b.blocked_replacement: retain incumbent and reconsider from the next completed close using the latest desired set; never sell first and leave an avoidable empty slot
architecture_b.insufficient_quality_universe: if fewer quality-valid daily alternatives exist than a frozen industry slot count, retain prior preferred incumbents for the unfilled slots; never introduce a quality-missing new name and never alter the industry count
architecture_b.t_plus_one: a day-t-close replacement fills no earlier than t+1 open; a lot bought at t+1 open cannot be selected for sale before the t+1 close decision and therefore cannot fill before t+2 open
architecture_b.initial_entry: same weekly Low-MAX selection and next-open cohort-capital rule as Architecture A; unexecutable initial slots are not later backfilled
architecture_b.forced_exit: accepted QD-010 pre-effective forced exits permanently close the slot and are not refilled
architecture_b.expiry: original cohort due open permanently closes every remaining lot; no replacement fills at or after expiry
architecture_b.weights: slot value rolls from incumbent proceeds into replacement after matched sell/buy costs; no daily full liquidation or weight rebalance

churn: same-cohort-industry consecutive-day Low-MAX Spearman rank correlation

half_life.event: a stock newly enters a cohort-industry preferred set while a prior preferred stock leaves
half_life.comparison: newly preferred minus newly rejected next-legal-open net return

classification.FAST_DECAY: h1 positive and h3/h5 no larger
classification.MULTI_DAY_PERSISTENT: h1/h3/h5 positive with h3 or h5 at least h1

GAPLESS_RANGE_ACCEPTANCE.event: absolute overnight coordinate gap <=0.5%; current range / prior-20 median range >=2; daily return 1%-8%; close location >=0.80; no upper-limit touch
GAPLESS_RANGE_ACCEPTANCE.control: same return/close/no-limit state with current range ratio 0.8-1.2
GAPLESS_RANGE_ACCEPTANCE.mechanism: large intraday information assimilation without an overnight discontinuity

COMPRESSION_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.event: prior-5 median range / prior-20 median range <=0.65; current range ratio >=1.5; daily return 1%-8%; close location >=0.75; no upper-limit touch
COMPRESSION_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.control: same current release/return/close state with prior compression ratio 0.9-1.1
COMPRESSION_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.mechanism: directional release after objectively quiet price discovery

OVERNIGHT_INTRADAY_ALIGNMENT.event: positive overnight coordinate gap 1%-5%; open-to-close return >=1%; daily return 1%-8%; close location >=0.75; no upper-limit touch
OVERNIGHT_INTRADAY_ALIGNMENT.control: same daily return/close state with absolute overnight gap <=0.2% and positive open-to-close return
OVERNIGHT_INTRADAY_ALIGNMENT.mechanism: overnight information receives same-direction regular-session confirmation

BROAD_INDUSTRY_NONLEADER_ACCEPTANCE.event: leave-one-out industry mean return >=1%, positive-return breadth >=70%, stock return 0.2% through the leave-one-out mean, close location >=0.75, no limit touch
BROAD_INDUSTRY_NONLEADER_ACCEPTANCE.control: same industry-date accepted positive stock with return at least one percentage point above the leave-one-out mean
BROAD_INDUSTRY_NONLEADER_ACCEPTANCE.mechanism: broad industry demand may leave accepted nonleaders with short-lived catch-up

INDUSTRY_SHOCK_RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION.event: leave-one-out industry mean return >=1%, stock-minus-industry return <=-2%, close location >=0.60, no limit touch
INDUSTRY_SHOCK_RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION.control: same industry-relative downside shock with close location <=0.30
INDUSTRY_SHOCK_RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION.mechanism: close recovery independently confirms mean reversion after a one-day industry-relative shock

track_b.matching: same decision date; exact PIT industry pool when nonempty then same-date fallback, nearest on daily return, log prior-20 amount, r20, and current range ratio using fixed scales [0.03,1,0.10,1]; outcomes excluded; deterministic symbol tie break; controls may be reused
track_b.outcomes: next legal open to legal open h1/h3/h5, 20 bps per side, with unresolved corporate actions fail closed
track_b.replay: at most one passing family; daily top 10 events by frozen event-strength ordering, equal-weight cohort, next legal open, fixed h3 expiry; no alternative rule

prohibited: Industry Diffusion signal, weekly clock, industry allocation, horizon, or exposure change
Low-MAX lookback, definition, orientation, tie break, or threshold change
2-day, 3-day, twice-weekly, weekday, or other frequency test
daily full liquidation or weight rebalance
Low Idio, Low Vol-of-Vol, Low Skewness, revised momentum, VWAP, support, leader/follower minute, price-limit lifecycle, or liquidity-transition combination
Track-B parameter, horizon, sign, control, Top-N, or action search
Track-B replay before every frozen promotion gate
PIT fundamentals, order-book, borrow, or investor-flow data
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claim
